svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Self-reported life satisfaction is measured on a scale
ranging from 0-10, where 10 is the highest possible life
satisfaction. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and
differences in living costs between countries.
Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)

tspan.tspan: GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021

text.tspan: prices. Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from
the closest year between 2020 and 2024 is shown instead.
